# Zephyr Observatory

> Zephyr is a first-of-its-kind interactive celestial observatory combining private browser-generated natal charts, readable visual astrology interpretation, and a solar harmony instrument that maps birthday positions in the year to musical intervals.

Canonical site: https://zephyr.guru/
Natal chart overview: https://zephyr.guru/natal-chart.html
Natal chart tool: https://zephyr.guru/?view=natal

## What Zephyr offers

- A free natal chart generator with planets, houses, Ascendant, Midheaven, retrogrades, and major aspects.
- Big Three and plain-language chart interpretations.
- Placidus, Whole Sign, Equal House, Koch, Campanus, Regiomontanus, and Topocentric house systems.
- Tropical and sidereal zodiac options.
- A Solar Harmonic Interval instrument that converts spacing between birthdays in the 365.2422-day solar year into musical cents, intervals, notes, and chords.
- Root-relative harmony views for comparing multiple birthdays.

## Required natal-chart inputs

A complete natal chart requires a birth date, exact local birth time, and birth city or latitude/longitude. Time and location are necessary to calculate the Ascendant, Midheaven, and houses.

## Privacy

Saved natal profiles are stored locally in the visitor's browser. Zephyr does not send birth details to a third-party astrology calculation API.

## Editorial position

Zephyr uses astrology, music, geometry, and storytelling as tools for reflection and entertainment. Interpretations are original, approachable, and non-deterministic. Zephyr does not make fear-based predictions.
